name: acryl-db
description: The db port: the relational database an app plugin sees through inject: ['db'], with numbered SQL migrations. Types and the migration runner; a provider (acryl-db-sqlite) serves it. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: it is the port, not a service: a plugin declares inject: ['db'] and imports its types from '../plugins/acryl-db/src/index.ts' (or the ctx.db type from '../plugins/acryl-db/src/cordis.ts'); add acryl-db-sqlite to provide it
